# jamfplatform_pro_disk_encryption_configuration (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro disk encryption configuration by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied. The data source never returns the plaintext IRK password — Jamf Pro does not return it on read. Use the resource (not the data source) to manage the password.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deployment | Disk encryption | Read | `disk-encryption-configurations` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_disk_encryption_configuration" "example_by_id" {
  id = "1"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_disk_encryption_configuration" "example_by_name" {
  name = "Individual recovery key"
}

output "disk_encryption_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_disk_encryption_configuration.example_by_id
}

output "disk_encryption_example_by_name" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_disk_encryption_configuration.example_by_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Disk encryption configuration ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Disk encryption configuration display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `file_vault_enabled_users` (String) Enabled FileVault 2 user (`Current or Next User`, `Management Account`).
- `institutional_recovery_key` (Attributes) Institutional recovery key block. Populated only when the configuration stores an IRK certificate (see the resource documentation for the empty-block read quirk). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--institutional_recovery_key))
- `key_type` (String) Recovery key type (`Individual`, `Institutional`, `Individual and Institutional`).

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--institutional_recovery_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `institutional_recovery_key`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_type` (String) Certificate format (`PKCS12`, `DER`, `PEM`).
- `data` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded recovery certificate payload.
- `key` (String) Certificate Subject DN. Returned by Jamf Pro; not user-settable.
